samples.question: Using the full printed row, each swap depends on the latest earlier swap touching either box. Cancel the red-X card. Try each shield separately: that shielded card stays even if it depends on a canceled card. Repeatedly cancel every other card that depends on a canceled card, then restart from START and do the swaps left. Which shield puts the GOAL shape in TARGET? Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
